$description: Tier 2: type roles (ADR-0040). Components use these families; sizes, weights and spacing come from the Tailwind scale (tier 1, ADR-0027).

body.$description: All body copy, film titles in captions, metadata and inputs

display.$description: Headlines, section titles, buttons, rank numbers and stamps. Weight 400 only, usually uppercase

label.$description: Typewriter labels: 'Feature Nº 1', reasons, the footer. Sentence case, never long text
